name: auf:method:net-equity@1
summary: Net equity: sum of priced asset positions minus sum of priced liability positions within the stated scope, in one denomination.

price.description: price per unit in the denomination

algorithm.description: value = sum(quantity_i * price_i * share_i over priced assets) - sum(quantity_j * price_j * share_j over priced liabilities). Positions without a usable price are excluded from the sum and listed under inputs.missing of the receipt; a material missing position makes the result kind insufficient-evidence.
algorithm.formula: value = sum_i q_i * p_i * s_i - sum_j q_j * p_j * s_j

assumptions: Prices are expressed in the output denomination at the stated time.
Restrictions (locked, pledged, contingent) are disclosed with each position and may be reflected by the evaluator through the price or through an explicit haircut recorded in params.

composability.conditions: For a composite, claims between parts of the composite cancel, a right shared by several parts is counted once at the share held by the Unit as a whole, and positions reached through more than one containment path are counted once.
